items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I'd been working with Ellis Larkin.

ctx.x: So it was the period when you were scuffling but you didn't go --
No, I'd been working with Ellis Larkin.

items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: when Ellis Larkins and I worked together

ctx.x: And 'Blues In My Heart' had always been a favorite of mine when I first started playing bass, Benny Carter, God bless him and when Ellis Larkins and I worked together, we used the same arrangement and the bass pattern that I got from Cliff Jackson, it went de-de-de-de- -- and I always used that.
Did you also do 'Bluebells of Harlem?' [ON WAX RECORDS]
